Consequently, the actual numeric cap of $25,000,000 and the per-year periodicity are entirely absent from the compiled representation. A user consulting this IR cannot determine the permitted aggregate amount, so the capacity-limiting effect of the source is lost. This is an omission, not merely a formatting defect, and it directly affects the ability to compute compliance. Because the IR claims COMPLETE sufficiency for both rules, the omission is especially consequential.
